name: magnesium citrate
uses: Uses for relief of occasional constipation (irregularity). Generally produces bowel movement in 1/2 to 6 hours
otcwarn: Ask a doctor before use if you have kidney disease a magnesium restricted diet abdominal pain, nausea, or vomiting noticed a sudden change in bowel habits that persists over a period of 2 weeks already used a laxative for a period longer than 1 week Ask a doctor or pharmacist before use if you are taking any other drug. Take this product 2 or more hours before or after other drugs. Laxatives may affect how other drugs work. Stop use and ask a doctor if you have rectal bleeding or failure to have a bowel movement after use. These could be signs of a serious condition.
